prerequisites: The student has solid knowledge of the subject matter discussed in the Networking fundamentals and Networking Architecture courses.

learning_outcomes.text: At the end of this course, the student will have in-depth theoretical and practical knowledge of enterprise-level networks. The student will know the techniques to make a network scalable to enterprise-level. The student will know when and how to efficiently apply these techniques, depending on the stated requirements.

At the end of this course, the student will be able to practically apply the learned concepts and techniques to available equipment. The student will be able to design a solution for a given problem. The student will be able to realize the chosen solution by configuring the equipment. The student will test the realized solution against the stated requirements.

At the end of this course, the student will be able to make provisions for long-term system management. The student will provide a management system for the various equipment configurations. The student will provide extensive reports on the configurations made. The student will document the work done with a view to long-term maintenance and management.

assessment_methods.method: Theory exam (written, open questions, closed book)
Lab (presentation/demonstration of lab assignment results and a final lab evaluation assignment)

assessment_rules: The overall grade is composed of a theory exam (40%) and a lab component (60%). For resits, a successful partial result for YT6046 - Networking Advanced: Theory and YT6047 - Networking Advanced: Lab can be carried over within the academic year. The same weighting applies for resits: 40% for the written theory exam and 60% for lab work, which may involve one or more assignments depending on previous scores.
